page_title: AUG 2-2 WER | Augsburg v Werder Bremen 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Sascha Stegemann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' Substitution. Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) replaces Senne Lynen.
90+3' The referee gives a yellow card to Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
90+3' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Samuel Essende (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) dinks a cross into the box from the free kick. However, the opposition defence thwarts the attack, preventing anyone from finishing.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Augsburg will take a free kick.
88' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Romano Schmid will be replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
86' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
83' The Augsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marvin Ducksch departs the field of play to be replaced by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
80' Here is a change. Arne Engels is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Steve Mounie (Augsburg).
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Marius Wolf (Augsburg) coming on for Dimitrios Giannoulis.
79' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Augsburg as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

78' Play continues despite the shouts by some Augsburg players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Sascha Stegemann interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
77' That looked a certain handball by Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
74' A cooling break is underway.
73' Flag up against Samuel Essende (Augsburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
72' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
72' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' A cross into the box from Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) is cleared. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
70' Celebrations are cut short for Augsburg as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
70' That looked like a handball in the build-up play and the referee Sascha Stegemann is going to take a look using VAR.
69' The Samuel Essende (Augsburg) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Sascha Stegemann rules it out for a handball.
68' A player from Augsburg commits a rough challenge. Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
66' Substitution. Phillip Tietz makes his way off the pitch and Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
66' A cross from a corner kick by Augsburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
65' A long ball forward to Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is intercepted. The ball goes out for a corner. Augsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
62' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. It will be a corner kick for Werder Bremen.
61' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
60' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
59' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) replaces Tim Breithaupt.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arne Maier trots off the pitch and is replaced by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg).

58' 2 - 2 Goal! Mitchell Weiser hands Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the left side of the goal. 2:2.
57' Sascha Stegemann interrupts the game. One of the players from Augsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
55' Arne Engels (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.

53' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
52' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

51' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Nediljko Labrovic keeps it out with an amazing save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Augsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' Arne Maier (Augsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The referee blows his whistle, Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Niklas Stark is replaced by Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen).
46' Half-time substitution. Ole Werner decided to make a change. Keke Topp is replaced by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes.
43' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul after Samuel Essende (Augsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
39' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
37' Sascha Stegemann sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
36' Wait! Referee Sascha Stegemann has indicated he is going to review the Augsburg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
35' 2 - 1 Goal! Samuel Essende (Augsburg) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Tim Breithaupt and easily beat the keeper with a header into the middle of the goal from close range. 2:1.
33' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Nediljko Labrovic is alert and denies him.
31' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Sascha Stegemann no option but to blow his whistle.
27' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
23' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Werder Bremen are ruled offside.
19' Total attempts – 4:1. Shots on target – 2:1.

16' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Michael Zetterer just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
15' Great teamplay by Werder Bremen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' 0 - 1 Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!
9' Michael Zetterer pulls off a great save to deny Arne Engels (Augsburg), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
8' The game is interrupted. Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
7' A player from Augsburg commits a rough challenge. Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
7' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michael Zetterer intercepts the ball.
1' Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight and sees a foul from Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
